Retro NYC: Hip, cool modem is easy to come by in Manhattan, especially downtown. But 
chic, in Midtown? Now there is an amazing new option. 
L'Avenue, one of our favorite Parisian hangouts, is now open for lunch and dinner on the 
eighth floor of Saks Fifth Avenue with a louche after-hours lounge that looks more like Gstaad 
EFTA_R1_01111773

or St. Moritz than Manhattan. 
Up for a farther flung adventure? Last week's opening of the stylish—very stylish-510 
room TWA Hotel at the recently revamped and historic JFK terminal that closed some 18 
years ago is not to be missed. With a nod to its original modernist design by Eero Saarinen the 
hotel rooms have spiffy retro furnishings, even rotary dial phones. Don't forget to make a 
reservation at the restaurant by Jean Georges Vongerichten there.
